notes.title: Trading Cards Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hey there!

Trading cards have been released, and one will be dropped every 30 minutes of playtime. We've also doubled the amount of XP gained to shorten the grind. We're still waiting on Valve to approve the new price tag, so we'll inform you once it happens!

notes.title: Patch Time!
notes.notes: We've updated the game, and introduced new backgrounds to prevent it from looking dull. We're also busy implementing the new Steam API so that we can add achievements, but we're running into some issues that need to be sorted out first. We've also started running events, and the first one is Double Rank Points! Stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Trading Cards
notes.notes:
Hey all,

So we released Gal-X-E, and we stated that it comes along with trading cards. It appears Valve didn't approve the cards yet, and we pressed the release button without double checking. Our apologies, and we hope to present you with cards within the next 48 hours!
